Developer. Tool-maker. Shipper.

I'm Yoav. I build software that earns its place on your device: cross-platform utilities, mobile apps, games, and a packet analysis stack. Each one is shipped, maintained, and held to a high standard of craft.

I care about how software feels, not just what it does. That usually means native UI where it matters, one shared core where it doesn't, and a release pipeline that makes shipping boring.

So far that's 5 projects across macOS, iOS, Android, desktop and the browser. The writing covers how each one came together.
